en.runTitle: Sydney to Bangkok: one lower-molar implant, about AUD 6,500 quoted at home, travel possible in March 2027

fields.label: Missing tooth and clinical plan
fields.value: Lower molar, already extracted; bone looked OK on the last X-ray; one single-tooth implant

fields.label: Itemised local and overseas quotes
fields.value: Sydney dentist quote of about AUD 6,500

fields.label: Actual stage dates and travel costs
Written fund benefits
fields.value: Private extras cover with a typical annual dental limit

fields.label: Time-off value
fields.placeholder: e.g. 5 working days off at AUD 300 a day

fields.label: Local follow-up and warranty terms
fields.placeholder: e.g. 5-year warranty on the implant, free checks in Bangkok only

en.template: Compare Sydney care and Bangkok treatment for {tooth}, using {quotes}, {stages}, {fund}, {timeoff} and {warranty}. Show cash, extra-trip exposure and missing costs. Ask before contacting clinics, submitting forms or sharing records.

phases.title: Read published clinic prices and Australian guidance from public sources
phases.note: Bangkok clinic price pages, Australian official advice on dental tourism, health fund rules
phases.judgment: It did not take the cheapest-looking numbers at face value. Two clinics’ package prices expire on 30 November 2026, so none is confirmed for March 2027, and an older 49,000-baht entry on one price page was not used as the headline price.

phases.title: Build the cost scenarios and the decision guide
phases.note: Sydney versus one Bangkok trip, two trips and a longer stay, with assumptions labelled

phases.title: Independent check of the arithmetic and of how the guide looks on desktop and phone
phases.judgment: The independent check recomputed all figures (every currency conversion, stage total and rebate matched) and still found one thing to fix: a clinic’s 80,000 and 85,000 baht prices were shown against two named implant systems, but the source only gives a range, so it asked for the row to be shown as a range.

workers: Read Australian official advice on dental tourism, implant risks and timing, and whether Australian health funds pay for treatment overseas
Found published single-implant prices at four Bangkok clinics, noting the implant brand, what each price includes, how long it is valid and the warranty
Recomputed every figure on its own from the written inputs, without using the first draft’s calculations, and checked the guide’s claims against the source notes

fields.label: 缺牙位置及临床方案

fields.label: 本地和海外分项报价
fields.value: 悉尼牙医报价约 6,500 澳元

fields.label: 书面保险给付
fields.value: 有私人附加险，牙科年度限额为常见水平

fields.label: 请假价值

zh.template: 请比较悉尼治疗和曼谷种牙：{tooth}、{quotes}、{stages}、{fund}、{timeoff}及{warranty}。列出现金、额外返程风险和缺失费用。联系诊所、填表或分享病历前先征求我同意。

phases.title: 从公开资料查清诊所公布价格和澳洲官方提示
phases.note: 曼谷诊所价目页、澳洲官方的海外牙科提示、保险公司条款
phases.judgment: 它没有照搬看起来最便宜的数字：两家诊所的套餐价 2026 年 11 月 30 日到期，所以没有一个价格能确认到 2027 年 3 月；某价目页上一条较早的 49,000 泰铢旧价也没有被当作主打价格。

phases.title: 搭建费用情景和决策指南
phases.note: 悉尼、曼谷往返一次、两次和长住的对比，假设都标明

phases.title: 独立核对计算，并检查电脑和手机上的页面效果
phases.judgment: 独立复核把所有数字重算了一遍（每个汇率换算、阶段合计和返还都对得上），还是挑出一处要改：某诊所的 80,000 和 85,000 泰铢被对应到两种植体系统，但来源只给了一个区间，于是要求改成区间显示。

workers: 查阅澳洲官方对海外牙科的提示、种植牙风险和疗程时间，以及澳洲健康险是否赔付海外治疗
查到四家曼谷诊所公布的单颗种植牙价格，并记下品牌、报价含哪些项目、有效期和保修
不用初稿的计算，从书面输入独立重算每个数字，并对照来源笔记核对指南里的说法
